name: Space Radio
description: A synced web radio player for everyone in a space. Editors pick a station from a list of public web stations — rock, pop, ambient, jazz, French, Italian, Australian, NPR, chiptune and more — and everyone else, including anyone the frame is shared with publicly, listens along to the same station at the same time. Play/pause and the station are shared; each listener's volume and mute are their own. The stations' stream origins are declared in permissions_media, so the page may play audio from them and reach nothing else. The play state is the session's own state in the space, so two radios in one space play apart.
